name: society-mgmt-300k
description: Society management synthetic test project (Ajit-backprop-test). Minimal stub package.json created by the environment-setup agent so the documented npm workflow can run; replace when real project files are processed.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'),vm=require('vm');let n=0;const r=d=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))return;for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const f=p.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())r(f);else if(f.endsWith('.js')){new vm.Script(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'),{filename:f});n++}}};['src','tests'].forEach(r);console.log('build OK: compiled '+n+' .js files')"
scripts.test: node -e "const {test}=require('node:test'),fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'),vm=require('vm');const files=[];const r=d=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))return;for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const f=p.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())r(f);else if(f.endsWith('.js'))files.push(f)}};r('tests');if(!files.length){console.log('no test files found');process.exit(0)}for(const f of files){test('compiles '+f,()=>{new vm.Script(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'),{filename:f})})}"
